statements.text: Construction companies, automakers and beverage manufacturers in the state are caught in the middle of a trade war filled with plenty of back-and-forths.

A 25% tariff on all steel and aluminium imports went into effect on March 12, under the umbrella of Section 232 of the 1962 Trade Expansion Act.
On August 15, the US Department of Commerce expanded the list of goods subject to these 50% tariffs, adding 407 product categories of steel and aluminium derivative products
